rules.statement: A court has the power to rectify mutual mistakes in a deed when it appears that as a result of such mistake, the parties have expressed an intention different from their actual intention, especially in partition actions.
rules.supporting_quote: "it seems to me however that rightly understood the controversy with which we are concerned relates riot to the construction of a 252 deed but to the nature and extent of the Court's power to give relief against mistake when it appears that as a result of mutual mistake the parties have expressed in the deed an intention different from their actual intention."

meta.parties: Marshal Perera and Others v. Dona Aginis and Another
